Hi Marcus / team,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the SIG spreadsheet (Atlas_SIG_Request.xlsx) — we've pre-populated the sections we need completed and marked high-priority items in red. Target: we need a completed response set plus evidence pointers by EOD Jan 14 to align with our security review.
